title: Define the Babulus service API for automation clients
description: A small, stable surface other products (Chatticus first) can call: create a campaign/brief, request a video deliverable (async job with an idempotency key and status), pack and queue posts (never auto-post; consequential actions need human approval), and report results and cost. Backed by the Kanbus objects (babulus-09376e). Auth: IAM service principal plus an acting-user/bot header, as Chatticus does for Kanbus, or Prospectus delegation; Ryan to decide.
